scope: Additional actual assessment of the current Cloud Connected compatibility section and linked SAIA-9918; supersedes an unsupported positive current Enterprise path in the intermediate candidate, not a saved-task execution.

sourceAssessments.evidence: Current installation guidance excludes Cloud Connected for SAIA 2.2.0 through 2.3.6. Its fallback is 2.1.1, explicitly without Agent Mode. Planned 2.4.0 support in late November is not released availability.

sourceAssessments.section: SAIA-9918 Cloud Connected access and 2.1.1 workaround
sourceAssessments.evidence: SAIA-9918 says 2.3.6 users cannot reach Cloud Connected and offers a 2.1.1 downgrade workaround. It does not independently establish Agent Mode support in that workaround.

The feature page still describes Agent Mode for Enterprise through Cloud Connected in 2.1+; this general feature statement is not reconciled with the current installation and known-issue restrictions.
